title.zh-Hant: 法國戰役：敦克爾克撤退結束（1940-06-04）
title.en: Campaign in the West: end of the Dunkirk evacuation (1940-06-04)

asOfNote.zh-Hant: USMA Map 13「Situation 4 June」：圖上明示的單日戰況。控制紀錄只取這一天（[1940-06-04, 次日)）；與下一個快照之間屬推估（§9），不延長。
asOfNote.en: USMA Map 13, "Situation 4 June": a single dated situation. Control records cover that day only; the span to the next snapshot is interpolation (§9).
